$comment: The skills the bus implements: the hub's skills rows (supabase/seed/skills.sql) and the parameter bounds the bus checks are generated from this by codegen.py. Parameters travel as key=value tokens of a run command; types here describe their values.

goto.description: Fly to a position with ArchHUD's autopilot and stop there: it lands under the target on a planet, and stops near it in space.

pos.description: systemId,bodyId,lat,lon,alt as in ::pos: degrees and metres above sea level. Body 0 is deep space, with world x,y,z in place of lat,lon,alt

tol.description: arrival tolerance in metres: horizontal on a planet; in space, straight and beyond the AutopilotSpaceDistance that ArchHUD stops short of the target (5000 m by default). Default 50 on a planet and 1000 in space

timeout.description: seconds of running time, pauses excluded, before the job gives up

preconditions: no ArchHUD travel mode is set and no ArchHUD route is loaded
the fuel the trip needs is above dub.cfg.minfuel (10%)
the target body is in ArchHUD's atlas
postconditions: done: the ship has stood still for 5 s within tol of the target
cancelled, timed out, or failed on the way: the autopilot is off, the throttle is 0 and the brake is set

examples.$comment: Checked against args_schema (companion tests) and against the bus's own check (lua/spec).
